snippet.title: Hexen 2: Storm over Thyrion Trailer
snippet.description:
First trailer for the upcoming mod Storm over Thyrion for Hexen II. Music from the trailer is remixed version of the original theme from Kevin Schilder for Hexen 1, made by Ransu.

https://www.moddb.com/mods/storm-over-thyrion
